summary: The diff implements most requirements for the video player page including HTML5 video player, bold title, subscribe button with frontend hooks, expandable description, comments section, and related videos sidebar. However, the backend subscription functionality (REQ-3) is incomplete - hooks exist but throw 'coming soon' errors. The implementation shows evidence of all frontend requirements with proper component structure and styling.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend tracks subscription relationships between users and channels
missing_requirements.reason: The backend (main.mo) does not contain any subscription tracking logic. The frontend hooks (useSubscribe.ts, useSubscriptionStatus.ts) explicitly throw 'Subscription feature coming soon!' errors and return placeholder values.

hallucinated_features.description: Video like functionality with heart button and like tracking
hallucinated_features.reason: The VideoPlayer page implements a like button using useVideoLike hook and handles like state, but this was not requested in any requirement. The BuildRequest only mentions Subscribe button, not video likes.

hallucinated_features.description: Share video functionality with clipboard copy
hallucinated_features.reason: The VideoPlayer page implements a Share button with Share2 icon and clipboard copying functionality. The BuildRequest explicitly lists 'Video sharing or embedding features' as a non-goal.
The VideoPlayer page includes Edit button and VideoEditModal component for editing videos. This was not requested in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: View count increment tracking on video load
hallucinated_features.reason: The VideoPlayer implements automatic view count incrementing via useIncrementVideoView hook when video loads. This analytics feature was not requested in any requirement.
